purpose: Portable SDLC skills pack. Core skills (26) provide universal engineering discipline installed by default; Extras skills (37) provide stack, domain, or specialist capabilities loaded on demand.

upstreams.selection_rationale: Engineering backbone: discovery/refinement, feature specification, planning, TDD, incremental implementation, interfaces, review, security, CI/CD, release and observability. The optional generic router is deliberately omitted so the pack has one default router.
transformations: Localize shared Markdown reference links inside each selected skill so installed skills remain self-contained.

items.note: Portable default for root-cause debugging in this pack; avoids a duplicate Addy debugging skill.

upstreams.selection_rationale: Adds a strong evidence-before-completion gate, structured debugging, code-review interaction, worktree isolation, and subagent orchestration patterns that complement the Addy engineering library.
Curated skills for Playwright web application testing, frontend design guidance, MCP server building, and technical document coauthoring.
Deep modules, domain modeling, ticket breakdown, codebase architecture improvement, pre-commit automation, git guardrails, and writing clear prompt instructions for agents.
Product discovery customer research, quantitative analytics tracking taxonomy, and A/B test experimentation.
React and Next.js modern best practices, web design guidelines, and technical documentation editorial standards.
Cross-cutting STRIDE threat modeling and abuse case analysis.

Selected engineering skills from sickn33/agentic-awesome-skills covering database design, docker containerization, k6 load testing, terraform IaC, and kubernetes orchestration. Code is MIT licensed, documentation CC BY 4.0.
